sections.installation: Upload the ZIP file or install it directly from the admin panel.
sections.changelog: Version 1.8.2: Fixed certificate upload rejecting valid passphrases that contain special characters (such as <, > or %) or surrounding spaces; build toolchain updated to Node.js 24 LTS (security).</br>Version 1.8.1: Documentation update: changelog, upgrade notice and FAQ for the 1.8.0 changes.</br>Version 1.8.0: The MySQL TRIGGER privilege is no longer required (ALTER is needed for the automatic migration); more reliable payment processing with optimistic locking, idempotent order completion and automatic reconciliation via WP-Cron; Express Checkout stores shipping rates at check-in and keeps unfinished orders as checkout drafts; translatable Express Checkout button label; all twint/v1 REST routes now require the X-TWINT-Nonce header (custom integrations must send it); CORS restricted to trusted origins.</br>Version 1.7.12: Removed external Google Fonts requests; Roboto font is now bundled locally.</br>Version 1.7.11: Legacy PKCS#12 certificates are converted automatically for OpenSSL 3 (PHP 8.4); clearer error for an empty certificate; fixed QR code being covered and a JavaScript error when showing messages.</br>Version 1.7.10: WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.0 compatibility; fixed TWINT Express Checkout occasionally showing a payment error or leaving the QR window open after a successful payment.</br>Version 1.7.8: Saved gateway settings are kept on plugin update; editable title and description in block checkout; iOS Express Checkout re-launches the TWINT app after cancel; a confirmed payment is captured before a retry cancels it; diagnostics downloads restricted to plugin managers.</br>Version 1.7.7: Returning to checkout after cancelling in the TWINT app on Firefox Android; spacing between payment label and icon.</br>Version 1.7.6: Improved accessibility of the TWINT payment label.</br>Version 1.7.5: Support for network-activated WooCommerce on multisite.</br>Version 1.7.4: SOAP requirement check in the Diagnostics tab; WooCommerce redirect is only blocked for TWINT checkout responses.</br>Version 1.7.3: Skip the WooCommerce redirect after the TWINT modal is shown.</br>Version 1.7.2: Fixed CSS class conflicts with Bootstrap and a shadow root issue on Firefox.</br>Version 1.7.1: Fixed missing URL handling in the checkout gateway.</br>Version 1.7.0: TWINT SDK 1.8.2; bug fixes.</br>Version 1.2.7: Bug fixings and improvements</br>Version 1.2.4: Enhance the warning message for PHP-CLI support in admin areas and improve security</br>Version 1.2.2: Support NSS servers</br>Version 1.2.1: Fixing issue relative to modal display in checkout page when select other payment methods</br>Version 1.2.0: Scoped styling for admin UI to prevent conflict with WP Cookie Consent plugin.</br>Version 1.1.1: Apply scoped styling to the payment modal to prevent unintended overrides from themes.</br>Version 1.0.2: Improved security and bug fixes.
